Hi Grace,

Thanks again for walking us through the onboarding call this morning. We received confirmation that our trial credits were approved on your side (HubSpot shows the approval on the DL-13829 deal) but the PaperTrail team dashboard still shows a $0.00 credit balance and we can't run evaluation workloads.

I attached a screenshot of our account billing page and the HubSpot approval emails. Can you confirm whether the credit issuance is queued or if there's an extra step we missed on our side? Wanted to avoid doing any more tests until we know credits are actually available.

Appreciate a quick check — our PoC demo is scheduled for Tuesday and we need the credits to finish smoke tests.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz

Hi Lena — thanks for the note and the screenshot. Sorry for the trouble here.

Quick summary of what I see on our side: HubSpot shows the deal as approved and an approval note was added by the account team at 08:58 PT. The automation that normally creates the credit grant in the billing service sometimes stalls if the webhook retries fail.

Two asks to help me triage faster:
- Can you confirm the account ID you see in the top-right of the PaperTrail dashboard (looks like PT-XXXXX)?
- If you have any acceptance-test timestamps from the PoC run attempt, send those too.

I’m looping in our infra engineer, Aditya, and our accounts ops lead, Sean, to take a look at the grant flow and logs. I’ll follow up with the next update within a couple of hours.

Best,

On Fri, Apr 2, 2027 at 09:41, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com> wrote:
> I’m looping in our infra engineer, Aditya, and our accounts ops lead, Sean, to take a look at the grant flow and logs.

Thanks Grace — I pulled the webhook and billing logs for DL-13829. The automation posted a grant request at 08:59:12 PT and the billing service returned 200, but the downstream reconciliation job that updates the customer-facing balance failed with a single exception: a JSON parse error on the kv-cache payload at 09:00:04. That caused the job to abort without marking the grant as reconciled.

I’ve attached the trimmed log lines. Short-term fix: I can manually reconcile the grant for PaperTrail and trigger the reconciliation job again. Before I do that, a couple notes:
- I will record the manual grant in the internal ledger so accounting doesn't double-issue.
- Leaving the failing payload in S3 for further postmortem, but will re-run the job against a sanitized payload.

Grace/Sean: please confirm I should proceed with the manual reconcile. If you want, I can add a temporary alert to detect future JSON parse failures so we catch this earlier.

— Aditya
Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

Can you confirm you now see the balance and run your smoke test? If anything else pops up, I’ll keep Aditya on standby to investigate.

Thanks and apologies for the disruption — we’ll follow up with a short postmortem next week and a Jira ticket for a permanent fix (INF-5917).
